answer_excerpt: SEC evidence indicates Goldman Sachs has no disclosed direct OpenAI exposure: full-text search returns zero OpenAI hits. Its 10-K frames any such counterparty failure under general third-party credit and concentration risk, explicitly warning concentration increases potential for significant losses across market-making, underwriting, investing and financing, plus derivatives credit risk. Critically, the 10-K discloses no numeric single-name concentration limit and no OpenAI-specific bound, so an OpenAI bankruptcy cannot be shown as capped by SEC disclosure; impact would depend on undisclosed actual concentration and correlated exposures, likely manageable if diversified but potentially significant if concentrated.
